lisbon.name: Lisbon
lisbon.tag: Tiles, hills & a whole other skyline
there: From Santo António dos Cavaleiros: local bus toward Campo Grande.
Metro to the start shown for your chosen walk.
back: Check live transit to 2660-213 before leaving the centre.
After the Metro closes, compare CARRIS night buses and a direct taxi / Bolt. Night buses alone may not get you home.

sintra.name: Sintra
sintra.tag: A forest with palaces hidden inside
there: Reach Rossio or Oriente and take a CP train to Sintra.
For the hilltops, use the local tourist bus or a booked ride. Do not follow the narrow road on foot just to save time.
back: Check the CP return and the final connection from Lisbon to Loures before departing.

cascais.name: Cascais
cascais.tag: Salt air, turquoise coves & open sky
there: Reach Cais do Sodré in Lisbon.
Take the Cascais-line train to Cascais, or Estoril for the promenade walk.
back: Both walks finish at Cascais railway station.
Check the train to Cais do Sodré, then your onward journey to Loures.

almada.name: Almada
almada.tag: Look back at Lisbon from across the water
there: Metro to Cais do Sodré, then ferry to Cacilhas.
Follow upper-town streets to the viewpoints, not the old Ginjal waterfront.
back: Return to Cacilhas by local transport or upper-town streets.
Check the ferry to Cais do Sodré and the onward connection to Loures.

tomar.name: Tomar
tomar.tag: Templar stone, deep green & slow river water
there: Use CP to plan Lisbon → Tomar; confirm whether your train is direct or changes at Entroncamento.
Tomar station is a straightforward walk from the historic centre.
back: Check and save a return train before starting. This is a day trip, not a spontaneous late-night excursion.

coimbra.name: Coimbra
there: Book a train to Coimbra-B from Lisbon Oriente / Santa Apolónia.
From Coimbra-B, check the current city connection toward Portagem. Do not assume the old Coimbra-A rail shuttle still runs.
back: Allow time to reach Coimbra-B before your booked return.
Use the current Metro Mondego / city-bus planner for the station link.

obidos.name: Óbidos
obidos.tag: White lanes inside a medieval storybook
there: Plan the regional coach from Lisbon Campo Grande to Óbidos.
Use the coach stop outside the historic town; the railway station is less convenient.
back: Return to the same regional-coach area outside the gate.
Check that day’s last departure before entering town. Do not rely on a late-night coach.

evora.name: Évora
evora.tag: Roman columns, whitewashed lanes & big Alentejo skies
there: Plan CP from Lisbon Oriente / Entrecampos to Évora.
Walk from Évora station toward the walled centre.
back: Allow the walk back to Évora railway station.
Book or confirm the return in advance; services are less frequent than Lisbon commuter trains.

parque.name: Parque Eduardo VII
parque.cue: A long green slope framing the city.
parque.about: Start at the upper viewpoint, then head downhill.

saopedro.name: São Pedro de Alcântara
saopedro.cue: A tiled city map beside a broad terrace.
saopedro.about: The opposite hillside spreads out like a model city.

carmo.name: Carmo Convent
carmo.cue: Gothic arches open to the sky.
carmo.about: The square and exterior work as a free stop. The roofless interior needs a ticket.

rossio.name: Rossio
rossio.about: Fountains, paving and the theatre make this a useful centre-of-town reset.

senhora.name: Senhora do Monte
senhora.cue: Castle, rooftops and river in one panorama.
senhora.about: The climb is the point: stop here long enough to take in the whole city.

graca.name: Graça viewpoint
graca.about: A second angle across the hills before descending into Alfama.

luzia.name: Santa Luzia
luzia.cue: Blue tiles, a pergola and red rooftops.
luzia.about: One of the most recognisable Alfama viewpoints.

se.name: Lisbon Cathedral
se.cue: Two square towers like a fortress.
se.about: A strong visual landmark on the descent toward the river.

praca.name: Praça do Comércio
praca.cue: A yellow square opening directly onto the Tagus.
praca.about: Walk through the arch and across to the river edge.

ribeira.name: Ribeira das Naus
ribeira.about: A flat riverside pause after the hills.

bica.name: Bica street
bica.about: Exterior walking stop only; this route does not depend on the funicular operating.

pink.name: Pink Street
pink.cue: The coloured street beneath the bridge.
pink.about: A short, livelier detour, not a peaceful park. Skip it for a quieter night.

maat.name: MAAT riverfront
maat.cue: White tiles flowing like a wave.
maat.about: Enjoy the exterior and riverfront; check access before assuming the rooftop is open.

padrao.name: Padrão dos Descobrimentos
padrao.cue: A stone prow full of figures facing the water.
padrao.about: The exterior monument and riverside square are the main stop here.

belem.name: Belém Tower
belem.cue: An ornate tower at the waterline.
belem.about: This route promises the exterior view, not interior access.

jeronimos.name: Jerónimos Monastery
jeronimos.about: An exterior stop; allow additional time and a ticket for the cloister.

oriente.name: Gare do Oriente
oriente.cue: Steel branches forming a huge canopy.
oriente.about: The transport hub is part of the architecture experience, especially after dark.

pavilion.name: Pavilhão de Portugal
pavilion.cue: An impossibly thin suspended concrete canopy.
pavilion.about: Look at the curve from the open square rather than expecting an indoor visit.

oceanario.name: Oceanário promenade
oceanario.cue: A building appearing to float on water.
oceanario.about: The waterfront is the stop; aquarium admission is a separate daytime visit.

tower-vg.name: Vasco da Gama Tower
tower-vg.cue: A sail-like tower above the waterfront.
tower-vg.about: Follow the public promenade and turn back if the path becomes uncomfortably quiet.

cerca.name: Casa da Cerca
cerca.cue: A hilltop house and terraces facing Lisbon.
cerca.about: The garden is a daytime stop with opening hours; use upper-town streets to approach.

bocavento.name: Boca do Vento upper viewpoint
bocavento.cue: The cliff-top outlook over the river.
bocavento.about: Stay at the upper viewpoint. The itinerary does not need the lift or the Ginjal path.

cristo.name: Cristo Rei
cristo.cue: The giant monument above the bridge.
cristo.about: Allow time for the grounds. The viewing platform requires separate access.

sintra-palace.name: Sintra National Palace
sintra-palace.about: Start in the old town. The exterior is a useful landmark even without a palace ticket.

mouros.name: Moorish Castle
mouros.cue: Stone battlements snaking along the ridge.
mouros.about: Steep steps and exposed walls. Skip the ramparts in strong wind or poor conditions.

pena.name: Pena Palace
pena.cue: Red and yellow towers above the forest.
pena.about: Reserve the appropriate ticket and time slot. Leave time between the park entrance and the palace.

regaleira.name: Quinta da Regaleira
regaleira.cue: Gothic stonework and mysterious garden paths.
regaleira.about: A separate ticketed garden visit; check entry availability before going.

monserrate.name: Monserrate Palace & park
monserrate.cue: An ornate palace set in botanical greenery.
monserrate.about: A quieter garden-led alternative to stacking every Sintra monument into one day.

cascais-bay.name: Cascais bay
cascais-bay.cue: Boats and a small bay below the old town.
cascais-bay.about: Wander the seafront streets without committing to a beach day.

marechal.name: Parque Marechal Carmona
marechal.cue: Leafy paths behind the museum quarter.
marechal.about: A shaded daytime pause; park gates may close before sunset.

santamarta.name: Santa Marta lighthouse
santamarta.cue: Blue-and-white lighthouse beside a small inlet.
santamarta.about: The exterior and surrounding water make the photo stop.

boca.name: Boca do Inferno
boca.cue: A rock arch with the Atlantic rushing below.
boca.about: Use the designated viewing areas; stay well back from unguarded edges.

tamariz.name: Tamariz promenade
tamariz.cue: A castle-like building beside the sandy bay.
tamariz.about: Start the flat seafront walk from Estoril toward Cascais.

guincho.name: Guincho outlook
guincho.cue: Dunes, a huge Atlantic horizon and frequent wind.
guincho.about: A daylight extension for strong walkers. Check a bus back instead of assuming you will want to retrace it.

coimbra-university.name: University of Coimbra
coimbra-university.cue: The palace courtyard above the river.
coimbra-university.about: Views and monumental architecture; book the spaces you want to enter.

joanina.name: Joanina Library
joanina.about: Timed ticketed visit. Treat this as optional: the exterior route still works without a booking.

sevelha.name: Old Cathedral of Coimbra
sevelha.cue: Romanesque stonework in a tight old-town square.
sevelha.about: Look for the fortress-like façade before climbing to the university.

botanic.name: Coimbra Botanical Garden
botanic.cue: Formal terraces giving way to dense greenery.
botanic.about: A daytime garden visit; check gate hours and use the open signed paths.

mondego.name: Parque Verde do Mondego
mondego.cue: Open riverbanks beneath the old city.
mondego.about: A broad, lower-effort finish after the university hill.

santaclara.name: Santa Clara-a-Velha
santaclara.cue: Gothic ruins on the other side of the river.
santaclara.about: Exterior viewpoint or a separate museum visit, depending on time.

tomar-praca.name: Praça da República
tomar-praca.cue: Geometric paving below the castle hill.
tomar-praca.about: The church square is a good orientation point before the climb.

tomar-mata.name: Mata dos Sete Montes
tomar-mata.cue: Shaded woodland paths and formal garden edges.
tomar-mata.about: The former convent woodland is a place to slow down. Only follow open signed paths.

tomar-convent.name: Convent of Christ
tomar-convent.cue: Templar walls, carved stone and cloisters.
tomar-convent.about: Make this the main ticketed visit of the day, not just a pin to clear.

mouchao.name: Jardim do Mouchão
mouchao.cue: Green river-island paths and a wooden waterwheel.
mouchao.about: A gentle riverside contrast to the castle hill.

pontevelha.name: Ponte Velha
pontevelha.cue: The old bridge over the Nabão.
pontevelha.about: Finish with river reflections and a look back at the town.

obidos-gate.name: Porta da Vila
obidos-gate.cue: A tiled gateway inside the town entrance.
obidos-gate.about: Go through the main gate into the historic streets.

ruadireita.name: Rua Direita
ruadireita.cue: White walls, colourful trim and narrow paving.
ruadireita.about: Leave the busiest spine briefly for the quieter adjoining lanes.

obidos-church.name: Santa Maria square
obidos-church.cue: A small church square inside the walls.
obidos-church.about: A pause between the lanes and the castle end of town.

obidos-castle.name: Óbidos Castle exterior
obidos-castle.cue: Stone towers enclosing the medieval town.
obidos-castle.about: Enjoy it from ground level. The exposed wall-top walk is optional, not required.

giraldo.name: Praça do Giraldo
giraldo.cue: Arcades and a fountain in a broad square.
giraldo.about: The main square anchors an easy old-town loop.

evora-se.name: Évora Cathedral
evora-se.cue: A massive stone cathedral over whitewashed streets.
evora-se.about: Exterior stop; buy the appropriate ticket for the interior or rooftop.

evora-temple.name: Roman Temple
evora-temple.cue: A row of Roman columns against the sky.
evora-temple.about: One of the strongest visual contrasts in the old town.

evora-garden.name: Jardim Público
evora-garden.about: A daytime breather before the walk back to the station.

routes.title: Rooftops & tiled terraces
routes.subtitle: The old city, seen from above
routes.caution: Steep cobbled climbs. Start early in hot weather; the hilltop views are worth taking slowly.

routes.title: The big Lisbon day
routes.subtitle: All the hills, all the way to the river
routes.extra: Add the Bica street detour before Cais if you still have energy.
routes.caution: A full outing, not a fitness test. Use the shorter old-city route when it is very hot.

routes.title: City lights & river air
routes.subtitle: A central night wander, not empty garden paths
routes.caution: Stay on lit streets and keep headphones low enough to hear your surroundings. No route is a safety guarantee.

routes.title: White waves & great explorers
routes.subtitle: Architecture with the Tagus beside you
routes.caution: Exposed riverside. Interior tickets and rooftop access are separate from this walking route.

routes.title: Lisbon from the future
routes.subtitle: Steel trees, a floating building, endless water
routes.extra: For a longer daytime walk, continue on the public waterfront toward Parque Tejo, then retrace to Oriente.
routes.caution: Use the central promenade after dark; skip remote garden extensions late at night.

routes.title: Across the water
routes.subtitle: A new perspective on the entire city
routes.caution: Uses upper-town streets. Ginjal has had access restrictions; do not use it as a shortcut. Check Casa da Cerca and Cristo Rei hours.

routes.title: Palaces above the clouds
routes.subtitle: A proper fantasy-world day
routes.caution: Book Pena’s timed entry. Use a local bus / booked ride for the hill transfer. Check official fire-risk closures before leaving.

routes.title: Secret gardens & palaces
routes.subtitle: Less rushing, more getting lost in the greenery
routes.caution: Both gardens need tickets. Use public transport / a booked ride between Regaleira and Monserrate; this is not a roadside hiking route.

routes.title: The Atlantic, up close
routes.subtitle: A bay, a garden, a lighthouse, a wild edge
routes.caution: Stay within marked cliff viewpoints. Park gates close; avoid the exposed cliff section after dark or in rough weather.

routes.title: Follow the blue
routes.subtitle: A low-effort coastal wander
routes.caution: You do not need to go onto the beach. Check the train home before lingering after sunset.

routes.title: Courtyards above the Mondego
routes.subtitle: Academic stone, garden shade & riverside calm
routes.caution: Book library visits separately. Use Coimbra-B for intercity trains; confirm the current city connection, and save the return train.

routes.title: Templars & river light
routes.subtitle: Ancient stone, deep woodland, a gentle finish
routes.caution: Allow time for the convent; check woodland gates and closures. Pre-plan the return train.

routes.title: Inside the storybook
routes.subtitle: White lanes and castle walls
routes.caution: The unguarded wall-top circuit is not part of the required walk. Check the return coach before going in.

routes.title: Stone, silence & big skies
routes.subtitle: Roman columns in a whitewashed world
routes.caution: Évora can be much hotter than the coast. Choose a cooler day and avoid midday heat; confirm the return train.
